posts.text: The Clorox Company and Fastenal hit ex-dividend date today, Wednesday. Clorox pays $5.00 annually with a 5.72% yield, while Fastenal pays $1.04 annually with a 2.02% yield.
Riley Exploration Permian raised its annual dividend from $1.60 to $1.68 on Oct 27. This marks a 5.0% increase, bringing the annual rate to $1.68 in USD.
Allwyn AG increased its dividend by 40.0% from EUR 0.50 to EUR 0.70, seen on Oct 23. The company currently holds a 1-year dividend streak.
Intertek Group PLC announced a dividend cut on Oct 28, lowering the annual rate from GBP 1.65 to GBP 1.08, a decrease of 34.5%.
Diageo plc reduced its annual dividend from $3.32 to $2.00 on Oct 17. This change represents a 39.8% decrease in the annual payout.
Microsoft raised its dividend to $3.92 and Texas Instruments to $6.08, both seen on Oct 16. Microsoft's payout grew 7.7% while Texas Instruments' grew 7.0%.
In the Technology sector, 39 of 62 companies are rated safe. The median 5-year average yield is 1.27% with a median dividend growth of 9.0%.
Six companies go ex-dividend on Friday, Oct 30, including Realty Income, A.O. Smith, NiSource, Costco, Texas Instruments, and Zoetis.
